description: Reading-B variant of the face feedback ('the actual mouth with teeth is a bit lost in this'): the simplified face keeps ONE crisp mouth - a glowing crescent grin under the eyes (Aku-style) - instead of going mouthless. Paint-only: same geometry as default. RETIRED by the artist's v3 ruling (2026-09-26: 'lets not have him have a mouth under his eyes'): not the default, no default render, and v3 geometry has no grin region, so this skin now paints the same as default. Kept on disk only as history.

grin.note: glowing crescent grin under the eyes
